required_dimensions.supported: Describe the source capability of the actual composition. An opaque caller-supplied collector needs an explicit capability declaration or an unknown state. Do not infer capabilities from a previous successful receipt.
required_dimensions.enabled: Report configured source selection independently of scheduled refresh enablement. Explicit manual acquisition can still use a selected source when automatic refresh is off.
required_dimensions.eligible: Unknown before real preflight. Evaluate dependencies, local workspace presence, credentials and applicable policy during acquisition. Status reads must not run probes or contact a secret manager.
required_dimensions.attempted: Record the actual Observe or provider-request boundary. Missing dependencies and cancellation before that boundary do not count as attempts. Rejected observations still count as attempts.
required_dimensions.accepted: Report usable local input in the active generation, independently of the last run. Preserve the existing complete-empty and partial-with-records rules. Failed publication cannot install new accepted state.

composition_constraints: Keep the verified distribution baseline distinct from local acquisition inputs. Git and HTTP variants remain alternatives under the existing selection validator.
Carry per-run evidence through errors that occur before Prepared exists. Successful-result-only metadata misses failed eligibility and attempts.
Do not store the last report on a shared SourceAcquirer object. Concurrent callers must receive separate per-run reports.
Keep provider scope and binding details in the existing provider-attempt report. Document any source-level aggregation when only some provider profiles qualify.
Persist or reconstruct accepted input as today. A restart with no fresh preflight cannot claim known eligibility from old accepted evidence.
Expose the same meaning in CLI output, HTTP operation/readiness responses, publisher diagnostics, and Starport connected runtime.
required_cases: Passive status before acquisition with unknown eligibility.
Explicitly disabled source: no acquisition and no revoked input after restart.
Selected Git source with a missing tool.
Configured source with a rejected observation identity.
Mixed eligible and unavailable provider profiles.
Valid partial input alongside source failure.
Publication rejection with preserved prior accepted state.
Two concurrent acquisitions on one collector with disjoint reports.
remaining: Choose a concrete report boundary, implement all composition paths, and add these behavioral cases. Existing focused tests do not qualify the full inventory.
